title: UFO researcher investigated 700 alleged alien abductions. He found one pattern that changed his belief about God
description: UFO researcher Joe Jordan says investigating around 700 alleged alien abduction cases over more than three decades changed his understanding of the phenomenon and strengthened his belief in God. According to Jordan, several people told him their experiences ended after they called on Jesus or God, prayed or sang hymns. One case involving a man identified as “Bill D” particularly influenced him after the man reportedly cried, “Jesus, Jesus, help me!” and the experience ended.
